title: Task schema migrations and rollback evidence
minimumPromotionPolicy: Task schema migration promotion requires versioned JSON descriptors, current/older/corrupt/unknown fixture coverage, fail-closed downgrade behavior, corruption recovery, packaged owner isolation, legacy TimedTask visibility, and runtime migration tests before live mutation is promoted.

schemaContract.legacyVisibilityPolicy: legacy TimedTask rows remain visible to Rhino and can be represented only as immutable NodeTimedTaskSnapshots

rollbackContract.safeProfileDowngrade: ignore Node task descriptors and keep legacy Rhino rows visible
rollbackContract.proProfileDisable: disable future Node task rows without deleting legacy TimedTask rows
rollbackContract.packagedDowngrade: remove or disable only rows owned by the packaged app identity
rollbackContract.corruptionRecovery: quarantine corrupt descriptors, emit stable diagnostics, and avoid scheduler reschedule
rollbackContract.unknownSchemaRecovery: preserve unknown future descriptors without mutation until a compatible migrator exists
rollbackContract.legacyVisibility: legacy Rhino task UI remains the source of truth for legacy TimedTask rows

requiredArchives.requiredEvidence: Runtime migration tests for current, older, corrupt, and unknown descriptor versions with stable pass/fail diagnostics.
Corrupt descriptor recovery evidence proving quarantine, no scheduler reschedule, and no legacy row deletion.
Safe downgrade and Pro disable evidence proving legacy Rhino TimedTask rows remain visible and Node descriptors fail closed.
Packaged rollback evidence proving packaged task rows are removed or disabled only for the owning package identity.
